title: eludite.view tool window state
description: Output of eludite.view.show, eludite.view.hide, eludite.view.float, eludite.view.auto_hide and eludite.view.dock: where the tool window (or document tab) is after the command.

state.description: docked: in a dock group; floating: in its own OS window; auto_hidden: on an edge strip; hidden: closed; document: a document tab.

side.description: Dock edge for docked and auto_hidden windows, and the edge a floating or hidden window returns to.

group.description: Tool windows tabbed together with this one (including itself), in tab order. Present for docked and floating windows.

active.description: Whether it is the visible tab of its group (or the active document).

flyout_open.description: For auto_hidden windows: whether it is slid out.
